ValidationRule.description: The Data Modeller Team and ESG Team should only able to change the status to Reopen
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), IsSystemGeneratedRecord = TRUE, ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c ,"ESG Team"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Re-Opened")) ) ,
AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), IsSystemGeneratedRecord = FALSE, OR( ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c ,"ESG Team"), ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c ,"Data Modeller") ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Re-Opened")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can change the status to Re-Open only
